parameters.query: INSERT INTO fpl_bootstrap (gw,data,updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2::jsonb,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (gw) DO UPDATE SET data=EXCLUDED.data,updated_at=NOW() RETURNING gw;
INSERT INTO fpl_teams (team_id,data,updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2::jsonb,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (team_id) DO UPDATE SET data=EXCLUDED.data,updated_at=NOW() RETURNING team_id;
INSERT INTO fpl_picks (team_id,gw,data,updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3::jsonb,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (team_id,gw) DO UPDATE SET data=EXCLUDED.data,updated_at=NOW() RETURNING team_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Get Current GW').first().json.teamId, $('Get Current GW').first().json.gw, JSON.stringify($('Fetch Team Picks').first().json)] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {model:$env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'qwen3:8b',think:true,stream:false,format:'json',options:{num_ctx:8192,temperature:0.3},messages:[{role:'system',content:'You are a careful Fantasy Premier League analyst. parameters.query: INSERT INTO fpl_suggestions (team_id,gw,suggestions,created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,NOW()) RETURNING id;

SELECT t.data AS team, (SELECT p.data FROM fpl_picks p WHERE p.team_id=t.team_id ORDER BY gw DESC LIMIT 1) AS picks, (SELECT b.data FROM fpl_bootstrap b ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS bootstrap FROM fpl_teams t WHERE team_id=$1;
SELECT suggestions::jsonb AS suggestions, created_at FROM fpl_suggestions WHERE team_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;
